text.content:
The nomads you'll meet most around Night City.

Kind: Nomad nation
Base: The roads; first formed by people leaving East Los Angeles
Purpose: Keeping the family free, fed and moving

Formed in 1993 when residents of East Los Angeles packed up and left, the Aldecaldos are the most common nomads around Night City. They led the nomad families who helped rebuild the city in the Time of the Red.

Gig hooks

  • The Aldecaldos need a negotiator in the city who won't be taken for a static.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.27
